# Frontend infinite re-render freezing the browser tab

Opening a specific page makes the browser tab freeze and eventually crash.

A useEffect updated state on every render without a proper dependency array, creating an infinite render loop that pegged the CPU.

1. Reproduce and confirm the maximum-update-depth error
2. Add the correct dependency array / guard to the offending effect
3. Verify renders settle and CPU returns to idle
4. Add a lint rule for exhaustive-deps to catch it in future

Error Details
```
Warning: Maximum update depth exceeded; React error: 'Too many re-renders'; CPU pegged at 100% in the render loop
```

Tags: frontend, react, infinite-render, max-update-depth, useeffect
